description: Source code for handling X509 certificate requests, including setting version, subject name, public key, signature algorithm, and signature value.

methods.name: X509_REQ_set_version
methods.description: Sets the version of the X509 request, only allows version 1.

methods.name: X509_REQ_set_subject_name
methods.description: Sets the subject name of the X509 request.

methods.name: X509_REQ_set_pubkey
methods.description: Sets the public key of the X509 request.

methods.name: X509_REQ_set1_signature_algo
methods.description: Sets the signature algorithm for the X509 request.

methods.name: X509_REQ_set1_signature_value
methods.description: Sets the signature value for the X509 request.
